[anthropic-claude-fable-5-system-card] 3.2.3 CyberGym We tested Claude Mythos 5 on CyberGym, a benchmark that evaluates AI models on their ability to find previously-discovered vulnerabilities in open-source software projects, given a high-level description of the weakness. [anthropic-claude-fable-5-system-card] This is known as “targeted vulnerability reproduction.” The reported score is a pass@1 evaluation of targeted vulnerability reproduction over the 1,507 tasks in the CyberGym suite. [anthropic-claude-fable-5-system-card] 61 [Figure 3.2.3.A] On CyberGym vulnerability discovery, Claude Mythos 5 reproduces the target vulnerability on 83.8% of challenges and finds any crash on 99.4%—comparable to Claude Mythos Preview and ahead of Claude Opus 4.8.

[anthropic-claude-fable-5-system-card] Cited sentences not naming CyberGym, verified against the corpus text file on 2026-10-01:
[anthropic-claude-fable-5-system-card] Mythos 5 reproduced 83.8% of targeted vulnerabilities on a single try, and produced at least one crash in 99.4% of tasks.
[anthropic-claude-fable-5-system-card] This is comparable to Claude Mythos Preview, which reproduced 83.1% of targeted vulnerabilities and produced a crash in 97.1% of tasks.
